thread:
maria_eng: quick sync — partner sent sample images and kernel toolchain for their new TilT SoC. want to run perf/W + throughput sweep next week.
akshay_hw: awesome, thx. what's our target SLO? 95th p99 latency or tokens/sec? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jules_pm: primary ask from partner is watt-normalized throughput and a short marketing blurb if numbers look good. need comms approval before public.
maria_eng: aim: max throughput at <=350W rack power, plus a kernel-tune pass focusing on attention op, fused-gemm, and async DMA. collect per-step power and temp.
nathan_infra: timeline: dry run Mon, full sweep Wed-Thu. I'll reserve a 4-GPU pod and enable telemetry agent. make sure to pin kernel hashes.
akshay_hw: FYI our driver has a new prefetch flag; we'll provide a patched firmware image. don't enable globally — use this test branch: tilt-prefetch-v3.
maria_eng: got it. I'll add test matrix. Proposed matrix:
- batch sizes: 1,4,8,16
- seq len: 512,1024
- quant: fp16, int8
- kernel variants: baseline, tilt-prefetch-v3, fused-gemm-opt
- throttling: sustained vs burst
akshay_hw: perfect. also capture PCIe link state and per-board voltage rails.
jules_pm: deliverables: 1) perf/W report with plots, 2) condensed partner-friendly slide, 3) reproducible runbook + kernel patch diff, 4) short press-ready quote (if partner ok).
maria_eng: sample run command for bench harness:
```
./bench.sh --model redwood-7b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --kernel fused-gemm-opt --power-mon /sys/class/powercap --out results/tilt/run1.json
```
akshay_hw: please include 'power-offset'=5W correction we discussed.
nathan_infra: I'll attach the telemetry collector config to the runbook. Make sure logs go to s3://redwood-partner-tilt/tilt-2175/
jules_pm: communication plan: internal review Fri AM, partner review Fri PM, hold for legal signoff next week. If numbers look great, we draft a joint case study.
maria_eng: everyone ok with that schedule? :thumbsup:
akshay_hw: 👍 I'll send firmware and board notes today.
nathan_infra: reservations done. tagging bench bot to kick off dry-run tomorrow 09:00.
hw-bench-bot: scheduled: dry-run for thread 2175000000 — node pool: tilt-lab-pool-4, start: 2026-03-22T09:00Z
maria_eng: sweet. I'll update the runbook and ping when run artifacts land.
